source.max_bbch: [AS] graminicides are selective for dicots; the sugar beet labels found (LfL Bayern empfehlungen_rube_5_graeser, ISIP lw-08 Zuckerrueben) time the treatment by the grass stage (BBCH 11-12 of the grasses, Targa Super label: ab 2- bis 4-Blattstadium der Ungraeser), not by a beet stage; the beet limit here is the row-closing stage.

source: F1c herbicide: a generic post-emergence grass herbicide (ACCase type). Every number [AS]; no product label was consulted. The sugar_beet row (farm needs, 2026-11-10) is the beet graminicide use: ACCase graminicides (fluazifop, quizalofop, cycloxydim) leave dicot crops untouched; the crop stage limit is [AS], the weed timing (grass at BBCH 11-12 to 2-4 leaf) is that of LfL Bayern / ISIP sugar beet grass recommendations (Fusilade Max, Targa Super).
